Welcome to Southern Laos This video was brought to you by "Southern Laos", an NGO seeking to increase the awareness of Southern Laos as a touristic destination. Welcome to Southern Laos , a captivating region where the mighty Mekong River carves its path through lush landscapes, ancient histories whisper from forgotten temples, and life unfolds at an incredibly gentle pace. Far from the bustling crowds, this enchanting part of Laos offers a truly authentic Southeast Asian experience, inviting you to slow down and immerse yourself in its unique charm. Here, you'll discover a remarkable diversity of attractions, starting with Pakse City , the vibrant hub where journeys often begin, offering charming riverside views and a glimpse into local urban life. From there, explore the cool, misty highlands of the Bolaven Plateau , cascading with magnificent waterfalls and rich with aromatic coffee and tea plantations. Journey further to the tranquil, timeless riverine world of 4000 Islands (Si Phan Don) , where you can unwind amidst scattered islets and witness stunning sunsets. History comes alive at the UNESCO World Heritage site of Vat Phu , an ancient Khmer temple complex that predates Angkor Wat, steeped in spiritual significance and architectural grandeur near the charming town of Champasak . As a local agency specialized in Southern Laos, Watphou Travels is uniquely positioned to help you explore this extraordinary region. Our intimate knowledge ensures you'll uncover hidden gems and experience the true essence of this beautiful part of Laos, making your journey truly unforgettable. Southern Laos is a destination for the curious traveler seeking genuine cultural encounters, breathtaking natural beauty, and a profound sense of peace. It's a place where every turn reveals a new wonder, waiting to be explored at your own relaxed rhythm. Our Best Seller Discover the essence of Southern Laos with our best-selling tours-crafted to give you an unforgettable journey through nature, culture, and comfort. From the misty highlands of the Bolaven Plateau, with its waterfalls and coffee farms, to the ancient Khmer temple of Vat Phu and the peaceful charm of the 4000 Islands, each experience reveals something unique about this beautiful region. These carefully selected tours are designed for curious travelers who want more than just sightseeing. Whether you're exploring hidden villages, tasting local flavors, or cruising the Mekong River, our Signature Experiences offer a deep connection to the land and its people—with professional service and flexible comfort every step of the way. No. 1 3-Day Classic Experience in Southern Laos Prepare for an unforgettable 3-day, 2-night adventure that gracefully blends the rich tapestry of Southern Laos. Explore the captivating Li Phi Waterfall and the immense Khone Phapheng Waterfall , often called the ' Niagara Falls of Southeast Asia '. Delve into ancient history at Vat Phu Temple before continuing to the refreshing allure of the highlands in Bolaven Plateau . VIEW MORE No. 2 6-Day Journey to the Heart of Southern Laos This six-day journey immerses you in a landscape rich with ancient heritage , living traditions, and remarkable natural scenery. You’ll explore towering waterfalls , vibrant highland communities, and serene countryside paths before experiencing meaningful cultural encounters such as traditional ceremonies and local homestays. The adventure concludes with time on a peaceful river island region , where tranquil waterways and gentle village life offer a perfect and memorable finish to your trip. VIEW MORE No. 3 Bolaven Plateau Classic Full-Day Tour Embark on a full-day exploration of the Bolaven Plateau , a region famed for its lush landscapes and waterfalls. Discover the powerful beauty of Tad Fane and Tad Yuang waterfalls, with a refreshing stop at Lak 40 Café . Continue to Ban Kok Phung Tai Market , a vibrant local market where villagers gather to sell fresh produce, forest herbs, woven textiles, and locally grown coffee. Your journey concludes with a visit to Tad Lo and a taste of local flavors at Mr. Vieng coffee , before returning to Pakse. VIEW MORE No. 4 4,000 Islands & Vat Phu Temple – 2-Day 1-Night This special program offers a perfect blend of peaceful river-island living and centuries-old heritage. Spend your first day unwinding in a tranquil island setting, then continue your journey to dramatic river cascades and scenic viewpoints shaped by both nature and history. On the way back, explore an extraordinary ancient temple complex that offers deep cultural insight and remarkable architectural beauty. VIEW MORE No. 5 5-Day Exploring Southern Laos A captivating 5-day, 4-night journey through Southern Laos , discovering ancient history, vibrant cultures, and breathtaking natural beauty. The adventure begins in Pakse, with a full day exploring the Bolaven Plateau's magnificent waterfalls and insightful coffee plantations. From Pakse, you'll travel to Champasak for an invigorating trek through rice fields to unique local sites , culminating at the majestic Vat Phu temple . Conclude your journey with two nights immersing yourself in the tranquil embrace of the 4,000 Islands .
